d:
Will Director Bean’s homemade horror production become a masterpiece, or is disaster already waiting behind the scenes?
Part of Mr Bean’s Spooktober Spectacular! New Halloween-themed videos arrive every Wednesday and Saturday, leading up to the special HallowBean Marathon on 31 October.
Experience the episodes of Mr Bean, the globally recognised comedy character created by Rowan Atkinson and Richard Curtis. Whether he is visiting the cinema, creating his own entertainment or dealing with an everyday disaster, Bean’s unusual solutions invariably produce complete chaos.
